articleTitle: Session Summary ISPW6 Opening Session
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 6th International Software Process Workshop 'Support for the Software Process'
abstract: The opening session of the 6th International Software Process Workshop was devoted to identifying general themes to be addressed during the course of the workshop. Opening presentations were given by Kumagai and Riddle. This was followed by a lively and wide-ranging discussion. The presentations and discussion are summarized in this report.
